# mtncloud_load_balancer_pool (Resource)

A group of servers (members) that a load balancer shares traffic across. A listener sends its traffic here through its `default_pool_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mtncloud_load_balancer" "web" {
  network_id = mtncloud_network.app.id
  name       = "web"
}

resource "mtncloud_load_balancer_pool" "web" {
  network_id       = mtncloud_network.app.id
  load_balancer_id = mtncloud_load_balancer.web.id
  protocol         = "HTTP"
  algorithm        = "LEAST_CONNECTIONS"

  # Keep a visitor on one server, by the application's own cookie.
  session_persistence = "APP_COOKIE"
  cookie_name         = "SESSION"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `algorithm` (String) How a member is picked: `ROUND_ROBIN`, `LEAST_CONNECTIONS`, `SOURCE_IP` or `SOURCE_IP_PORT`.
- `load_balancer_id` (String) ID of the load balancer, for example `mtncloud_load_balancer.web.id`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `network_id` (Number) ID of the MTN Network the load balancer is on, for example `mtncloud_network.app.id`. Your tenant must own it: a network shared with you is read-only. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `protocol` (String) How the load balancer talks to the members: `HTTP`, `HTTPS`, `PROXY`, `PROXYV2`, `TCP`, `UDP` or `SCTP`. Changing it replaces the pool.

### Optional

- `cookie_name` (String) The application's cookie, for `session_persistence = "APP_COOKIE"`.
- `description` (String) A description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the pool takes traffic (administrative state). Defaults to `true`.
- `name` (String) The pool's name.
- `session_persistence` (String) Keep a client on one member: `SOURCE_IP`, `HTTP_COOKIE` or `APP_COOKIE` (with `cookie_name`). Unset: none.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `tls_enabled` (Boolean) Encrypt the traffic to the members. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The pool's ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mtncloud_load_balancer_pool.web <network_id>/<load_balancer_id>/<pool_id>
```
